text: In a rural village in early 18th-century England, the farmer Ralph Gower [uncovers a deformed skull in a field|trigger|unsealing what was shut away], with one intact eye and strange fur, and it vanishes before the judge will look. Soon a young woman screams in a disused attic, and [patches of fur grow on the village children|images|wounded and changing bodies]. Led by Angel Blake, they skip scripture lessons for [games in a ruined church|threat|dangerous children], where a cult gathers to restore [the demon Behemoth|wants|a way into life].
